speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help me understand what you are dealing with, could you tell me if the rash appeared immediately after birth or developed a few days later?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Infection (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection presenting as pustular rash). The history of maternal gonorrhea and the onset of a generalized rash on day 4 are highly suggestive of this diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture, CSF Analysis, and Gonorrhea PCR from blood and skin lesions.
REQUEST IMAGES: Full-body dermatological examination photos.
